Name: Leaf Stables (Seasonal)
Author: izcw
Description:
[size=5]四季叶语·马厩
[/size]
为你的马儿打造一座随四季变幻的梦幻马厩！每一季都有独特设计：
春天：长出了嫩绿的藤蔓！
夏天：宽大叶片自然舒展，为马儿遮蔽烈日与骤雨。
秋天：金红渐染叶冠，与农场的丰收景象交相辉映。
冬天：厚实叶片垂下积雪，马儿在叶子下躲飘零的雪。

Build a dream stable for your horse that changes with the seasons! Each season has unique designs:
Spring: tender green vines have grown!
Summer: Wide leaves naturally stretch, providing shade for horses from the scorching sun and sudden rain.
Autumn: The golden red gradually dyes the leaf crown, complementing the harvest scene on the farm.
Winter: Thick leaves hang down with snow, horses hide from the drifting snow under the leaves.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Leaf Stables (Seasonal)
Manifest.Description: Add seasonal green leaf stables to your horse, seamlessly blending with the aesthetics of the farm, no longer having to smell dirty stables.
Manifest.Author: izcw
